title: A few new pages for your Sunday.
subject: New stories are waiting: Tunisia, Cusco & Colca Canyon
paragraphs: POSTCARDS FROM DAINYEL Take the scenic route.
A few new pages for your Sunday.
Fancy a little Sunday escape? There are new stories waiting on Dainyel on the Move, from North Africa to the Peruvian Andes.
One week in Tunisia for €700 My first African adventure: medinas, Roman ruins and a week of exploring on a budget.
Cusco wasn’t done with us yet Quad bikes, mountain lakes and the little corners that made me want to stay out exploring.
Going solo in Arequipa & Colca Canyon An overnight bus, a little independence and Andean condors above the canyon.
Pick a story, take your time, and leave me a question in the Q&A if there’s something you’d like to know about the journey.
See you on the scenic route, Dainyel
Enjoying the Postcards? You can buy me a coffee to support the next story. Thank you!
